headline: Indian Markets Prepare for Muhurat Trading as Samvat 2083 Begins Following Strong Rally

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Indian stocks bucked global tech routs to post their best week in six years.
Sensex surged over 1,700 points to cross the 81,000 mark driven by strong rally momentum.
Investors added Rs 8 lakh crore in a single day amid strong global cues and buying interest.
Nifty 50 enters Samvat 2083 maintaining levels above 25,000.
whatHappening: NSE conducts special Muhurat Trading today on Diwali Laxmi Pujan to kick off Samvat 2083.
LIC and Astral are in focus following their Q2 FY27 financial result announcements.
Peak XV and Y Combinator executed a Rs 2,457 crore stake sale in Groww.
Historical data highlights an 80% positive strike rate for Sensex and Nifty during Muhurat Trading sessions.
summary: Indian equities enter Samvat 2083 on a strong footing after posting their best week in six years, with Sensex crossing 81,000. Markets hold special Muhurat Trading today for Diwali Laxmi Pujan. Corporate highlights include Q2 FY27 results from LIC and Astral.
